name: @muen/dsh-codex-fold
description: Codex-style agent-loop folding for the DSH conversation, localized: finished turns fold, the thinking/tool/context runs between prose collapse into one summary chip per run, and expanding shows the native rows again. Forked from dsh-auto-collapse 0.2.1 (MIT) with every hardcoded string replaced by locale lookups, plus fixes for an icon-size and stylesheet-lifetime defect.
